target: INS versus DEL; within-type AP/AUROC are undefined
primary_interaction: high minus low native graph complexity in strict context
endpoint_complexity: maximum category at the two manuscript endpoint coordinates; start-only sensitivity
size_bins: retain existing HGSVC length_bin without outcome-dependent merging
frequency_bins: retain existing HGSVC af_bin; separate AC=1 count stratum
pvalue: exact two-sided sign flips of seed-averaged fold gains, descriptive under CV dependence
multiple_testing: BH within each context and stratification family, all prespecified estimable strata retained
bootstrap: existing paired 10000-draw chromosome-fold then seed method
